def transform(grid):
    # Four 4x4 panels are separated by single columns of 3s.
    # At each position, combine nonzero panel marks using precedence 9 > 8 > 5 > 4.
    rank = {5: 1, 8: 2, 4: 3, 9: 4}
    panels = [
        [row[0:4] for row in grid],
        [row[5:9] for row in grid],
        [row[10:14] for row in grid],
        [row[15:19] for row in grid],
    ]
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        line = []
        for c in range(4):
            vals = [panel[r][c] for panel in panels if panel[r][c] != 0]
            line.append(max(vals, key=lambda v: rank[v]) if vals else 0)
        out.append(line)
    return out
